title: State of Delhi & Telangana v. Instant Micro-Loan Extortion Syndicate
crime_type: Digital Extortion / Unauthorized Device Exfiltration / Cyber Defamation
court_or_authority: Cyber Crime Sessions Court, New Delhi / Hyderabad High Court
source: Delhi Police Cyber Cell & Indian Kanoon
ipc_sections: Section 385 IPC (Putting person in fear of injury in order to commit extortion)
Section 509 IPC (Word, gesture or act intended to insult modesty of woman)
evidence: Source code analysis of illegal APK loan apps extracting contacts, photo galleries, and GPS location upon installation
Call recording archives revealing abusive extortion agents threatening victims and sending morphed defamatory images to family contacts
Seizure of server logs hosted on foreign cloud infrastructure storing harvested contacts of over 1.2 million Indian borrowers
Cryptocurrency wallet trails tracing extorted loan repayments converted to USDT and remitted overseas
modus_operandi: Lured low-income individuals with offers of instant paperless micro-loans via untrusted Android apps. Required extensive permissions to harvest the entire phone contact book and photo gallery. After disbursing only 60% of the loan with exorbitant weekly interest, agents began relentless extortion, morphing victim photos onto obscene images and circulating them to their family and employer contacts.
personality_disorder: Coercive sadism, psychological intimidation, moral disengagement, and relentless harassment.
common_traits: Harvesting sensitive device data via deceptive loan apps
Morphing personal photographs for psychological coercion
Mass social humiliation of victims and family members
summary: Major multi-agency investigation smashing predatory Chinese-linked loan apps. Triggered the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY) blocking orders against hundreds of illegal lending applications and strict Google Play Store financial policies.
